sloka: त्वया प्रनष्टे तिलके तं किल स्मर्तुमर्हसि ।एष निर्यातितः श्रीमान् मया ते वारिसम्भवः ।। ५.६५.२३ ।।।।
transliteration: tvayā pranaṣṭe tilake taṁ kila smartumarhasi ।eṣa niryātitaḥ śrīmān mayā te vārisambhavaḥ ।। 5.65.23 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O sinless one tell Rama that this auspicious Chudamani born in the ocean is sent to him and I was gazing at it as if it was him (Rama) and feeling happy.
